app.name: Reflex VLA
app.one_liner: Deploy any Vision-Language-Action model to edge GPUs with verified ONNX parity and one-command installation.

screens.name: Deployment Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display real-time inference status, model selection, and performance metrics for deployed VLA agents.

rust_commands.name: chat_fleet
rust_commands.purpose: Enable natural language interaction with deployed robot fleet using reflex chat.

rust_commands.name: serve_model
rust_commands.purpose: Launch a VLA model server with hardware-optimized execution providers and optional correction heads.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add bounded A2C2 correction head with Huber loss
week 1: Expose --cuda-graphs flag for low-jitter inference
week 1: Implement platform-aware installer with auto-extras selection
week 1: Integrate TensorRTExecutionProvider as default on NVIDIA GPUs
acceptance_tests: A2C2 correction head must produce bounded outputs (±3.0) and restore 8/10 task success on LIBERO after catastrophic regression fix.
Installer must detect Jetson Nano and exit early with unsupported hardware message.
ONNX export must achieve cos = +1.000000 parity across SmolVLA, pi0, pi0.5, and GR00T N1.6 on shared seeded inputs.
reflex serve with [gpu] extras must default to TensorrtExecutionProvider and achieve ≥5.5× speedup on A10G vs ORT-CUDA fallback.
